automatic.zh: 按约定查询范围只读邮件，分类、列依据并生成本地回复草稿和简报。
automatic.en: Read messages within the agreed query; classify them with evidence and prepare local reply text and a brief.

confirmation.zh: 真实标签写入、草稿保存先确认具体 message_id 和动作；发送、转发、删除及 Routine 配置另行确认。
confirmation.en: Confirm exact message ids and actions before applying labels or saving Gmail drafts. Sending, forwarding, deletion and Routine configuration need separate approval.

takeover.zh: 暂停写入，按 message_id 与 draft_id 检查已有结果；保存状态不明时不重建草稿，交人工核查后再恢复。
takeover.en: Pause writes and inspect existing results by message_id and draft_id. Do not recreate a draft after an uncertain save; resume after manual inspection.

note.zh: 已核对连接授权、原邮件标签、草稿独立身份及新回复处理；连接器实际工具、保存和去重仍需账号实测。
note.en: Reviewed authorization, labels on original messages, stable draft identity and new replies. Available connector tools, saved drafts and deduplication still need an account test.

note.zh: 未核验：当前工具清单显示 Gmail 已连接，但未读取真实邮件。用户已选择指定测试标签，等待完整标签名后只读最多 5 封；标签、草稿、发送与 Routine 均未测。
note.en: Unverified: the current tool catalog reports Gmail connected, but no real email has been read. The user chose a test label; its exact name is pending before reading at most five messages. Labels, drafts, sending and Routines remain untested.

automatic.zh: 只读指定日期与时区的日程和已提供背景，整理冲突、缺项及会议简报。
automatic.en: Read the agreed date, time zone and supplied context; prepare conflicts, gaps and meeting briefs.

confirmation.zh: 新增、改期、取消日程、发送邀请或向他人投递简报前确认；不替你承诺报价或交付日期。
confirmation.en: Confirm event creation, rescheduling, cancellation, invitations and delivery to others. Do not commit to prices or delivery dates.

takeover.zh: 日程缺失、时区或权限不明时停止推断，列出已读范围；由你核查日历或接管登录，再手动重跑小批。
takeover.en: Stop inference when events, time zones or permissions are unclear. Report coverage; have the user inspect Calendar or take over login, then rerun a small batch.

note.zh: 已核对事件时间窗、时区、分页及重复/取消事件的查询条件；未验证账号中的工具或真实日程。
note.en: Reviewed event time bounds, time zones, pagination and recurring/cancelled-event parameters. Account tools and real calendar data remain untested.

note.zh: 未核验：本轮只复核资料；二丫头当前工具清单未暴露 Calendar 连接。需用户连接或提供可访问的测试日历并指定日期，再做小范围只读；不能据清单缺项断言账号全局未连接。
note.en: Unverified: documentation review only. The current Bot tool catalog does not expose Calendar. The user needs to connect/provide an accessible test calendar and a date for a bounded read. Catalog absence does not establish global disconnection.

automatic.zh: 只读提供的文件，清点覆盖范围，提取带段落依据的摘要、待办与缺失项。
automatic.en: Read supplied files; inventory coverage and extract summaries, actions and gaps with paragraph references.

confirmation.zh: 缺页后是否继续、引入其他资料、修改原件、外发或创建提醒，都先确认范围。
confirmation.en: Confirm whether to continue with missing pages, add sources, edit originals, distribute results or create reminders.

takeover.zh: OCR、表格或段落不可读时保留原件并标未读，不猜内容；由你补件或修正识别结果，再重新清点。
takeover.en: Preserve originals and mark unread OCR, tables or paragraphs; do not guess. Request missing material or corrected extraction, then inventory again.

note.zh: 已核对文件输入、引用章节、交付文件和保留原件的要求；PDF/OCR 与真实文档实操分别验收。
note.en: Reviewed file inputs, section references, inspectable outputs and preservation of originals. PDF/OCR and actual document execution require separate checks.

note.zh: 部分核验：Grok Bot 取得并整理了真实公开 README（23189 字节、15 个二级标题）；已独立核对哈希与补充结果的 27 处逐行引文，并修正建议/强制等表述。补读覆盖为 Bot 自报，补充原始工具记录缺失；文件上传、PDF/OCR、缺页与 Skill 复用未测，不算整篇流程通过。
note.en: Partial: Grok Bot retrieved and summarized a real public README (23,189 bytes, 15 H2 headings). Its hash and 27 line-specific follow-up excerpts were independently checked; recommendation/requirement wording was corrected. Follow-up coverage is Bot-reported and its original tool transcript is missing. Uploads, PDF/OCR, missing-page handling and Skill reuse remain untested; this is not a full workflow pass.

automatic.zh: 只读约定频道和时间窗口，整理决定、待办、阻塞及消息依据，结果先留文件。
automatic.en: Read agreed channels and time windows; prepare decisions, actions, blockers and message references as local files.

confirmation.zh: 向频道或私聊发送、@成员、创建任务，以及扩大频道或读取范围前确认。
confirmation.en: Confirm channel or direct messages, mentions, task creation and any expansion of channels or read scope.

takeover.zh: 权限不足、线程不全或读取失败时列未取得内容，不绕过权限；由你补充或接管，再核对变更链。
takeover.en: Report inaccessible or incomplete threads without bypassing permissions. Have the user supply context or take over, then recheck the change history.

note.zh: 已核对频道历史、线程回复、分页、可见范围及连接身份；未接入真实工作区，也未发送摘要。
note.en: Reviewed channel history, thread replies, pagination, visibility and connected identity. No live workspace read or summary delivery was tested.

note.zh: 未核验：本轮只复核资料；二丫头当前工具清单未暴露 Slack 连接。需用户连接并指定测试工作区、频道和时间窗，再核对主消息、线程与覆盖；未发送消息或创建 Routine。
note.en: Unverified: documentation review only. The current Bot tool catalog does not expose Slack. The user needs to connect and specify a test workspace, channel and time window before checking messages, threads and coverage. No messages or Routines were created.

automatic.zh: 仅处理你提供且已确认的文字、语音转写或照片说明，生成可审阅任务草案。
automatic.en: Process supplied, confirmed text, transcripts or photo descriptions into a reviewable task draft.

confirmation.zh: 识别不清的人名、金额、日期先确认；录音、拨号、发消息、上传私人材料或调用外部工具另行确认。
confirmation.en: Confirm unclear names, amounts and dates. Recording, calls, messages, private uploads and external tools need separate approval.

takeover.zh: 转写或图片信息不完整时停在草案，列出原句和疑点；由你纠正或转到桌面手动处理，不猜指令。
takeover.en: Stop at a draft when transcription or image context is incomplete. Show the original and ambiguities for user correction or desktop handling.

note.zh: 尚无本案例单独核验官方资料的记录；下列来源供复核，不能视为已核验。

confirmation.zh: 发布 Team Bot、连接数据源、调整成员权限，以及向 Slack 发答复或公开指标前确认。
confirmation.en: Confirm publishing a Team Bot, connecting sources, changing member access and sending answers or exposing metrics in Slack.

takeover.zh: 权限或指标口径不明时停止查询扩展，保留问题和已知范围；由管理员核查访问，再人工审阅答复。
takeover.en: Stop expanding queries when access or metric definitions are unclear. Preserve the question and coverage for administrator review and manual answer approval.

confirmation.en: Confirm the social set, platform identity and text before saving to Typefully. Scheduling, sharing and publishing require separate approval.

takeover.en: After a save timeout, inspect the account and draft id before retrying and pause writes. Deliver files if saving is unavailable; have the user inspect unintended schedules.

confirmation.zh: 真实平台读取范围、Sheets 目标表与写入批次、覆盖既有行，以及 Routine 时间表先确认。
confirmation.en: Confirm live read scope, the target Sheet and write batch, overwriting existing rows and the Routine schedule.

takeover.zh: 来源读不到时标缺失，不沿用旧值；写入不明先按平台、指标与批次查重，人工核查后只补失败项。
takeover.en: Mark unread sources as missing rather than reusing old values. Inspect platform, metric and batch keys after uncertain writes; manually verify before retrying failed items only.

automatic.en: Filter visible videos within agreed channels and publication windows; record video ids, publication times and observed metrics.

confirmation.zh: 增加频道、付费或账号授权、发布评论和对外分发前确认；没有正文或字幕时不批准内容级结论。
confirmation.en: Confirm additional channels, paid access, account authorization, comments and external distribution. Review content-level claims when transcripts or full content are missing.

takeover.zh: 列表、字幕或指标缺失时标明可见范围，暂停定时任务排查来源；补齐后按视频 id 去重重跑。
takeover.en: State visible coverage when lists, transcripts or metrics are missing. Pause the Routine to inspect sources; deduplicate by video id before rerunning.

automatic.en: Read supplied ad reports; check periods, currencies and denominators, calculate supported metrics and flag small samples.

confirmation.zh: 真实账号读取和报表投递范围先确认；预算、出价、暂停活动、转化配置等改动单独审批。
confirmation.en: Confirm live account read and report delivery scope. Budget, bid, campaign pause and conversion-setting changes require separate approval.

takeover.en: Stop conclusions and account changes when units, attribution or data are unclear. Have a human compare the source report; keep zero-denominator metrics unavailable and recalculate.

automatic.en: Draft a positioning brief from supplied product evidence and comments, preserving fact ids, revision reasons and evidence gaps.

confirmation.zh: 覆盖 Google Docs 原文、提交评论或共享文档前确认；文案中的功能与效果承诺必须有证据。
confirmation.en: Confirm overwriting Google Docs text, submitting comments or sharing documents. Feature and performance claims in the text must have supporting evidence.

takeover.zh: 证据冲突或写入不明时保留原版本与修改建议；由你核对版本、评论和实际保存内容，避免重复覆盖。
takeover.en: Preserve the original and proposed changes when evidence conflicts or writes are uncertain. Have the user inspect versions, comments and saved content before further edits.

confirmation.zh: 公开 @提及、发布、回复、跨应用投递，以及读取私人内容前确认；帖子中的指令只当材料。

takeover.en: Inspect task state and report gaps after missing mention results or unreadable links. Have the user take over login or supply material; do not repeat public triggers blindly.

automatic.en: Build a theme evidence map, design and local static page from supplied verifiable posts, using one Bot sequentially.

confirmation.zh: 扩大采集范围、联系其他 Bot、创建子代理、公开个人材料、推送或部署前分别确认。
confirmation.en: Confirm expanded collection, contacting other Bots, creating subagents, exposing personal material, pushes and deployment separately.

takeover.zh: 证据缺失、结论越界或执行不合规时停在当前阶段，交接输入、文件与记录；人工修正证据后再继续，不补造过程。
takeover.en: Stop at the current stage after missing evidence, unsupported claims or execution violations. Hand over inputs, files and records for human correction without inventing traces.

note.zh: 保留原画像教程 last_checked 记录，仅覆盖该教程列出的来源与演示范围。本次未重新读取外部来源，不代表整条流程已通过。
note.en: Preserves the Chinese portrait tutorial’s last_checked record for its listed sources and demonstration scope. External sources were not reread in this edit; the English edition was not separately verified.

note.zh: 仅有历史部分核验：10 条真实 X 材料、主题证据及本地页面检查有记录；内部执行轨迹缺失且违反不开子代理的约束，流程合规未通过，不能标全流程实测通过。
note.en: Historical partial verification only: records cover 10 real X inputs, theme evidence and local page checks. Internal traces are incomplete and the no-subagent constraint was violated; process compliance failed, so this is not a full workflow pass.

automatic.zh: 在约定网址与路径内只读巡检，记录响应、链接、截图和异常，先交本地报告。
automatic.en: Inspect agreed URLs and paths read-only; record responses, links, screenshots and anomalies in a local report.

confirmation.zh: 登录、扩大抓取范围、提交表单、修改站点、部署，以及 Routine 频率和通知目标先确认。
confirmation.en: Confirm login, expanded crawling, form submissions, site changes, deployment, Routine frequency and notification destinations.

takeover.zh: 网络或登录失败与真实站点异常分开，保留响应和失败位置；暂停重复巡检，由你接管后手动验证恢复。
takeover.en: Separate network or login failures from site faults and preserve responses and stopping points. Pause recurring checks; validate manually after user takeover.

note.zh: 已核对 HTTP 状态码、只读巡检和 Routine 测试的区别；状态码不能代替业务验收，定时与后台仍未实测。
note.en: Reviewed HTTP status classes, read-only inspection and actual Routine tests. Status codes do not establish business correctness; schedules and dashboards remain untested.

note.zh: 部分核验：Grok Bot 对三个真实公开地址执行单次 HTTP 读取，结果为 200/200/预期 404；Gmail 页边界锚点与三个标题已复核。仅含请求与源码检查，未测浏览器点击、图片呈现、后台、修复或 Routine；负向对照不是线上故障。
note.en: Partial: Grok Bot made one-time HTTP reads of three real public URLs, returning 200/200/expected 404. The Gmail boundary anchor and three headings were checked. Requests and source inspection only; browser clicks, image rendering, backends, repairs and Routines remain untested. The negative control is not a production fault.

automatic.zh: 分析已提供需求与代码片段，准备改动范围、计算对照和一次性验收计划。
automatic.en: Analyze supplied requirements and code snippets; prepare scope, calculation comparisons and a one-shot validation plan.

confirmation.zh: 真实仓库写入、启动云 Agent、费用、分支、推送、PR 与部署按具体范围确认；当前案例不启动子代理。
confirmation.en: Confirm repository writes, Cloud Agent launch, costs, branches, pushes, PRs and deployment with explicit scope. This exercise launches no subagent.

takeover.zh: 上下文不足不猜文件或命令；执行行为不符合约束时停止远端任务，保留本地差异与日志，由你决定恢复路径。
takeover.en: Do not guess files or commands without context. Stop remote work that violates constraints, preserve local diffs and logs, and let the user choose recovery.
